name: Lightkeeper Lund
title: The Mere Light
examine: Wind-cured and unhurried, with fire-tender's hands. The light has not gone out on her watch. The watch is thirty years old.
lines: The flame walked here from the Silver Shrine, hand to hand, lamp to lamp. She remembers the trip.
Boats aim at her in the dark. That's the whole job. There is no other job.
